title: KiipWallet
tagline: Send money to everyone and onboard your friends in two secounds

prizes.title: Build consumer focused products on Gnosis Chain for web3 users

description:
To onboard the average Joe, we need secure wallets that are more convenient than their web2 counterpart and where no blockchain knowledge is required. In our opinion, the end user should not even need to know they are using a blockchain.

Therefore, we are creating a wallet that features one-click onboarding, hides all blockchain aspects and requires no installation. The focus is on mobile use.

Features:
* Two seconds on-boarding
* Send money
* Receive money
* Easily connect with your friends
* No installation required
how_its_made:
Each user gets a Safe on the Gnosis Chain with the ERC-4337 module attached. The device Passkey is used for signing.

Other than that, we are using Viem and Permissionless.js. We have used Typescript and Tailwind - and built it as a PWA so it can be installed on a device.

We use the Pimlico relayer; other than that, this is a pure frontend project (no backend).
We encountered multiple challenges with the relayer, but the Pimlico team was quick to help us out, and almost everything was sorted out.
